templates.source: FLIR Support KB article 'FLIR Thermal Security Cameras - Opening and troubleshooting video issues' (flir.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5428): documents rtsp://camera_IP:554/stream1 as Visible 1 / main stream for FH-Series ID/R, DM-Series, DX-Series, DH-390 Dome, and FR-345-EST cameras.

FLIR Support KB article 'FLIR Thermal Security Cameras - Opening and troubleshooting video issues' (flir.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5428): documents rtsp://camera_IP:554/stream2 as Visible 2 / sub stream for the same series (FH-Series ID/R, DM-Series, DX-Series, DH-390 Dome, FR-345-EST).

FLIR Support KB article 'FLIR Thermal Security Cameras - Opening and troubleshooting video issues' (flir.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5428): documents rtsp://camera_IP:554/ch0 as Thermal 1 / primary channel for PT-Series, D-Series, A310pt, F-Series, FC-Series S/N/R, FC-Series ID/O, and PT-Series HD. Also confirmed for thermal-fusion cameras (ch0 = Thermal 1, ch2 = Visible 1 on PT/D-Series).

FLIR Support KB article 'RTSP - Display and record a video stream (Automation Cameras)' (flir.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1053) and FLIR support doc T506256 (support.flir.com/docdownload/assets/web/chxa/en-us/T506256.xml.html): documents rtsp://<IP>/avc as the H.264 stream for FLIR automation/science cameras (AX8, A400, A700, A40, A70, G300a). This path applies to the non-security automation line; confirmed lead.

FLIR Support KB article 'RTSP - Display and record a video stream (Automation Cameras)' (flir.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1053) and FLIR support doc T506256: documents rtsp://<IP>/mpeg4 as the MPEG-4 stream for FLIR automation cameras (AX8, A400, A700, A40, A70, G300a).

Maritime/thermal sensor path (port 8554) — same as /ir.1; maritime scope only, not IP security camera line.

PT-series PTZ visible-channel path (confirmed for PT-series in VisioForge FLIR docs), but cross-scope — applies to thermal PTZ cameras, not pure IP surveillance cameras. Could not confirm against an official FLIR security camera user manual.
PT-series wide field-of-view thermal path — thermal PTZ scope, not confirmed for standard IP security cameras.

Hikvision-style double-digit channel/subtype path (also /ch02/0, /ch03/0, /ch04/0, /ch05/0, /ch07/0, /ch09/0, /ch10/0, /ch012/0) — not in any FLIR official documentation; this is a well-known Hikvision-cross-contamination pattern in StrixCamDB leads. Excluded.

notes: FLIR's security camera product line spans two distinct families with different RTSP path conventions. (1) FLIR IP security cameras (FH-Series ID/R, DM-Series, DX-Series, DH-390, FR-345-EST) use /stream1 (main/visible-1) and /stream2 (sub/visible-2) on port 554; some of these also have /stream3 and /stream4 for thermal channels. (2) FLIR thermal security cameras (PT-Series, D-Series, A310pt, F-Series, FC-Series) use /ch0 (thermal-1) and /ch1 (thermal-2), with /ch2 and /ch3 for visible on dual-sensor models. FB-Series ID/O uses /stream1/sensor1 and /stream2/sensor1 — a nested path variant documented in the same KB but not represented as a lead here. (3) FLIR automation/science cameras (AX8, A-series, G300a) use format-based paths: /avc (H.264), /mpeg4, /mjpg — all on port 554, no authentication required by default. FLIR acquired Lorex and Digimerge; the FLIR IP Series cameras sold under those brands (N-series models, e.g. N233ZC) use the same firmware and RTSP conventions as the FLIR IP security camera family (/stream1, /stream2). Many leads in the StrixCamDB set for this brand are Hikvision-style /ch<N><N>/0 paths — these are cross-brand contamination and are excluded. Default port is 554 for all security and automation cameras; FLIR Maritime thermal cameras use port 8554 but those are out of scope here.
